title: GenDexHand: Generative Simulation for Dexterous Hands
authors: Feng Chen, Zhuxiu Xu, Tianzhe Chu, Xunzhe Zhou, Li Sun, Zewen Wu, Shenghua Gao, Zhongyu Li, Yanchao Yang, Yi Ma

tldr.zh: GenDexHand 以 LLM Agent 编排任务与仿真场景生成，借助 VLM 验证并修正场景，再拆解任务、选择规划器或 PPO 子策略并约束活动关节，自动收集成功操作轨迹。
tldr.en: GenDexHand uses an LLM agent to orchestrate task and simulation-scene generation, a VLM to verify and refine scenes, and subtask decomposition, planner/PPO selection and active-joint constraints to collect successful manipulation trajectories.

evaluation_scope.zh: Claude Sonnet 4.0 根据机器人与物体资产生成任务及场景配置；Gemini 2.5 Pro 检查三视角渲染，输出物体缩放、平移与旋转指令，由程序修改配置。该视觉闭环作用在场景生成。轨迹阶段，Agent 为子任务选择运动规划或 RL，并指定活动关节；接近／搬运用规划器，接触操作用生成奖励、成败判定和额外观测代码训练的 PPO MLP 子策略（隐藏层 1024／1024／512），阶段间冻结无关自由度。产出为成功轨迹及对应任务环境，不是一个共享多任务动作模型。SAPIEN 仿真、UR10e＋ShadowHand，1024 并行环境、20Hz 控制；策略量化对照集中在开柜门、抓瓶子、放苹果入碗三项任务，以收集 1000 条成功轨迹所需步数评估效率，场景展示不等于所有任务均完成大规模策略评测。尚无真机策略验证；跨手资产与任务适配仍需人工，附录的代码修正提示包含人工反馈。官方仓库当前仅 README，标注代码待发布；完整生成数据及策略权重未核实开放。
evaluation_scope.en: Claude Sonnet 4.0 generates tasks/configurations from robot/object assets; Gemini 2.5 Pro checks three-view renders and issues scale/translation/rotation edits applied to scene configurations. This visual loop refines environment generation. An agent assigns planners or RL and active joints per subtask: planners handle reaching/transport; PPO MLP subpolicies (hidden widths 1024/1024/512) learn contact operations from generated reward, evaluation and extra-observation code, with irrelevant DoFs frozen. Outputs are successful trajectories and task environments, rather than one shared multitask policy. SAPIEN experiments use UR10e + ShadowHand, 1,024 parallel environments and 20-Hz control. Quantitative policy comparisons focus on cabinet opening, bottle pickup and apple-to-bowl placement, measuring steps to collect 1,000 successful trajectories; scene showcases do not establish broad policy evaluation. Hardware policy transfer is not demonstrated; cross-hand adaptation needs human expertise, and appendix code-refinement prompts include human feedback. The official repository contains only a README marking code as forthcoming; full generated-data and policy-weight availability is unverified.
